originalTitle: Google replaced Git tags for certain source code with obtaining via Google Drive
content: Google replaced pushing Git tags for certain source code with obtaining source code via Google Drive after making a request through Google Forms. It's completely ridiculous and they've gradually become very slow at handling requests. They're in clear violation of the GPLv2 now.
chineseTitle: Google 将某些源代码的 Git 标签替换为通过 Google Drive 获取
chineseContent: Google 通过 Google Forms 发出请求后，通过 Google Drive 获取源代码，从而取代了推送某些源代码的 Git 标签。这完全是荒谬的，他们处理请求的速度逐渐变得非常慢。他们现在明显违反了 GPLv2。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
